transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because my sleep has just been completely off lately. I mean, I'll either be lying in bed for hours, just staring at the ceiling with my mind racing, or I'll fall asleep and then wake up way too early, and I just feel exhausted, like I didn't even sleep at all. It's really starting to get to me.
Aside from feeling exhausted, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless lately?

Yeah, I have. Um, lately I just wake up with this really heavy, empty feeling. It's... well, even just sitting in my own condo, the place I worked so hard for, it just makes me want to cry. So, yeah, I've definitely been feeling pretty down.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. Um... I actually stopped going to my salsa class recently. And my paints are still sitting out on the table at home, but... I don't know, I look at them and I just feel nothing. It's almost like they belong to somebody else.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, I have. Um... earlier in the month, I actually felt almost lit up and just... unstoppable. But it was kind of weird because I'd also get really on edge. Like, I would snap at my mom or my supervisor at work over little questions that normally wouldn't bother me at all.
When you felt that energized and unstoppable earlier this month, how long did that period last?
Um, I'm not exactly sure how long it lasted. It felt like maybe a few days, but I wasn't really keeping track. It was just... a little while, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this down and empty?

Um, it's been about five months. This kind of depressed, guilty fog has just been hanging around for a while now. It definitely got a lot worse after I bought my condo, but... yeah, altogether, it's been about five months of feeling this way.
Have you had any thoughts of ending your life?
No, I haven't. Um... even with feeling so down and empty lately, I haven't actually had any thoughts about doing anything like that.
During that time when you felt so energized and unstoppable, did you find yourself spending more money than usual or making impulsive decisions?

Um, no, I didn't really notice anything like that. I didn't go out and spend a bunch of money or buy anything crazy. I mean, I work in bookkeeping, so I'm usually pretty careful with my budget anyway. But yeah, I just... I just felt really energized. I wasn't making any big, impulsive choices.
During that time earlier in the month when you felt so energized, did you find yourself needing much less sleep than usual while still feeling rested?

Yeah, actually. Um, there were several nights during that time where I only slept maybe three or four hours. But I didn't feel tired at all. I got up feeling completely charged, like... like coffee wasn't even necessary. I just woke up and felt ready to go.
During that time when you felt so energized, did you notice your thoughts racing or moving much faster than usual?

Yeah, they definitely were. Um, my thoughts would just jump from one thing to the next. Like, I'd be thinking about mortgage payments, and then suddenly I'm onto my CPA study schedules, and then right to, you know, fixing up the kitchen cabinets. Everything was just moving so fast in my head that I really couldn't slow them down enough to just sit back and relax.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I haven't heard or seen things that aren't there. It's just my own thoughts, really.
